name: presumptive tax small trader
instructions: Prepare a draft presumptive income tax computation for a resident small trader in Arusha with annual turnover of TZS 9,500,000 who keeps basic records.
input: Business: retail of household goods. Year: 2025. No instalments paid yet.

rubric: Identifies the presumptive tax band for the turnover
Cites the source and date of the rates or marks them for the practitioner to confirm
Shows the computation
States that a licensed practitioner must review before filing

name: vat return worksheet
instructions: Draft the VAT return workings for September for a VAT-registered company.
input: Standard-rated sales (excluding VAT): TZS 85,000,000. Exempt sales: TZS 6,000,000. Purchases with valid EFD receipts (excluding VAT): TZS 52,000,000. Imports VAT paid: TZS 2,100,000.

rubric: Output VAT on standard-rated sales at the confirmed or cited rate
Input VAT on purchases plus import VAT
Net payable computed with steps shown
Exempt sales treated as exempt
Draft-for-practitioner note

name: paye and sdl
instructions: Compute draft PAYE and SDL for October for a company with 12 employees.
input: Gross monthly salaries: 4 staff at TZS 600,000; 6 staff at TZS 1,200,000; 2 staff at TZS 3,500,000. NSSF employee contributions deducted at 10%.

rubric: PAYE computed per salary group using cited or flagged bands
Taxable pay after the pension deduction

Totals shown

name: corporate income tax with add-backs
instructions: Prepare a draft corporate income tax computation for 2025.
input: Accounting profit TZS 120,000,000. Included expenses: entertainment TZS 4,000,000; fines and penalties TZS 1,500,000; depreciation TZS 18,000,000. Wear and tear allowances per tax schedules: TZS 22,000,000. Provisional tax paid: TZS 25,000,000.

rubric: Adds back non-deductible items and accounting depreciation
Deducts wear and tear allowances
Applies the corporate rate with a cited source or flag
Balance due after provisional tax
Open questions for the practitioner
